label: Median household income

source.name: American Community Survey 5-year estimates (tables B19013, B17001, B03002)

notes: Adjusted to 2024 dollars with the BLS CPI-U annual average.
Uncertainty is the 90% margin of error (not available for 2015–2019 and 2016–2020 here).
Each year is a 5-year average ending in that year (e.g., 2024 = 2020–2024), so recent changes show up slowly.
